items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: She became our manager when we started working in the "Monseigneur".

ctx.x: Before leaving Paris I gave Mae enough money for Beezie and Joan to go back to New York. Mae was coming to Egypt after "Spider" got settled there. She told me that Beezie was out of town, staying for a few days with a sick friend.

We had met a Belgium woman named Madame Piers who managed the Pingouin in Knocke. She had gone to Egypt when Willie Lewis went there and acted as his secretary. She did not stay in Egypt and was back in Knocke when we did the 1938 summer season. But she had fallen in love with some fellow in Egypt and came back to Alexandria after the season in Knocke and was working for Pastraudis. She became our manager when we started working in the "Monseigneur".
